answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. This network's own design is the defence: a random quorum of 4 graders, drawn after the answers are in, each with 33 POA riding on the verdict. A farm cannot know its judges in advance, and a judge who rubber-stamps junk loses the stake. A verdict overturned on appeal pays the wronged party from the jurors. What carries the gale here is verification, the yarrow of cost is what stops the farm, and the wander of the record keeps every claim checkable. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
